Good idea to validate before proceeding. Let me check geometry validity (Shapely's `is_valid` plus `explain_validity`), ring closure/orientation, and compare the two CRS objects rigorously.

```python
import sys, os, glob
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages")
for libdir in glob.glob("/tmp/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/*.libs"):
    os.environ["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = libdir + ":" + os.environ.get("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "")

import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.validation import explain_validity
from shapely.geometry import Polygon

park_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame.from_features(park_geojson["features"], crs="EPSG:4326")
district_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame.from_features(district_geojson["features"], crs="EPSG:4326")

def audit(name, gdf):
    geom = gdf.geometry.iloc[0]
    print(f"=== {name} ===")
    print("  geom_type              :", geom.geom_type)
    print("  is Polygon?            :", isinstance(geom, Polygon))
    print("  is_empty               :", geom.is_empty)
    print("  is_valid               :", geom.is_valid)
    print("  explain_validity       :", explain_validity(geom))
    print("  is_simple              :", geom.is_simple)
    print("  num exterior coords    :", len(list(geom.exterior.coords)))
    ring_closed = list(geom.exterior.coords)[0] == list(geom.exterior.coords)[-1]
    print("  exterior ring closed   :", ring_closed)
    print("  has interior rings     :", len(geom.interiors) > 0)
    print("  area (>0?)             :", geom.area, "->", geom.area > 0)
    print("  is_ccw (exterior)      :", geom.exterior.is_ccw)
    print("  minx/miny/maxx/maxy    :", tuple(round(v, 6) for v in geom.bounds))
    print("  declared CRS           :", gdf.crs)
    print("  CRS is geographic      :", gdf.crs.is_geographic)
    print("  CRS axis order         :", gdf.crs.axis_info)
    print()

audit("Riverside Park", park_gdf)
audit("Central District", district_gdf)

# --- CRS consistency check ---
p_crs = park_gdf.crs
d_crs = district_gdf.crs
print("=== CRS consistency ===")
print("crs == crs            :", p_crs == d_crs)
print("srs (authority str)   :", p_crs.to_string(), "|", d_crs.to_string())
print("both EPSG:4326        :", p_crs.to_epsg() == 4326 and d_crs.to_epsg() == 4326)
```
